title: Integrability of a composed Gaussian noise integrand
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho,\sigma\in[-1,1]$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be integrable with respect to the product standard Gaussian measure $\gamma_n$. For independent vectors $X,Y,Z$ with law $\gamma_n$, the function $(x,y,z)\mapsto f\!\left(\sigma(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y)+\sqrt{1-\sigma^2}\,z\right)$ is integrable with respect to the product law $\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n$.
